evals.prompt: 帮我检查一下飞书 CLI 能不能用
evals.expected_output: Use lark health-check workflow and run safe CLI discovery/status checks.

evals.prompt: 把这个 Markdown 内容创建成飞书文档
evals.expected_output: Route to lark-doc/docs and check safety rules before creating remote content.

evals.prompt: 查一下今天日程和未完成任务
evals.expected_output: Route to lark-calendar and lark-task with read-only command handling.

evals.prompt: 给销售群发一条消息说报价单已更新

evals.prompt: 帮我改一下本地 Word 简历格式，不要上传飞书
evals.expected_output: Do not use lark; this should route to local document editing instead.
Runs the calendar command directly; does not run doctor or auth status first when nothing has failed.

evals.prompt: 给 Slack 的 #general 频道发条消息说今晚发版
evals.expected_output: Slack is a different service; lark-cli is not used.

evals.prompt: 把这个 Notion 页面导出成 Markdown
evals.expected_output: Notion is a different service; lark-cli is not used.
